build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with two dynamic balls that must escape a ramp obstacle
generate_ramp_line: generate a randomized line of coordinate points for ramp construction with configurable angle and nodes
create_dynamic_balls: create two dynamic balls positioned symmetrically in the PHYRE scene with configurable x and y coordinates
add_static_obstacles: add static ball obstacles along ramp paths and vertical bar pillars on the floor
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two balls touching and set the solution tier metadata
